claim: Only opus-coder (or opus-everywhere) produces a VALID submission on v3 detecting; every cheaper or mixed routing fails the schema gate.
opus-everywhere reaches GOLD on v3 denoising, confirmed n=3, mean ~$10.4; per-node downgrade here DROPS a tier (E032), so keep opus across the board on this family.
opus on coder+aggregator (sonnet elsewhere) gives a VALID leaf submission at ~$12-17, ~60% cheaper than opus-everywhere; opus-all + bigger search reaches above_median.

opus is the primary coder for hard tasks -- 11 coder runs across denoising (gold), leaf, histopathologic, tabular-playground-may, mean ~$7.5/role. Spend opus on the coder where the task is hard, medal-critical, or schema-gated; cheaper coders suffice on easy/medium tasks.

opus on the DESIGNER role (with a sonnet coder) reached SILVER on text-normalization-english -- the planning role, not only the coder, is where opus pays off on some tasks. Consider opus-designer when the task's difficulty is in the approach/plan rather than the code.
